notes: STS-134's flown OPS 1 abort I-loads, from DASS_G16.ASC's PATCH SUMMARY (the flown G1/G6 load against the generic tape): every word whose tape value is the generic (LM) one and whose flown (MM) value differs, in these csects. Applied on top of the -full volume (sts134-gnc-iloads + sts134-ascent-iloads) to make -full2. See yaGPC2/ASCENT_ILOADS.md.

#PCGN13R, the OPS 1 landing-site table: blank on the tape (spaces and zeros). Flown: 90 runways -- KSC 15/33; TAL Ben Guerir 36/18, Moron 20/02, Zaragoza 30/12; the East Coast abort sites (MYR ILM NKT NTU WAL DOV ACY FOK FMH PSM YHZ YJT YYT YQX YYR); Lajes, Beja, Keflavik, Shannon, Fairford, Koln-Bonn, Istres, Esenboga, then the Pacific and western sites (KKI JDG AMB PTN JTY GUA WAK HNL EDF HAO EDT HAW NOR EDW); MLS and TACAN tables; CGGS_TARGET_INDEX, ALTERNATE_SITE_1/2. Only the G16 copy (load block @1087488): the G3 copy at flat addr+1130718 is entry's and is left alone.

#PCGN13R's G3 copy (entry's; flat = address + 1,130,718, load block @1328128): DASS_G3's flown words where the volume still holds the blank tape value -- slots 3-90 and their MLS/TACAN entries, for a TAL's or ECAL's OPS 3 (OPS 304 keeps the OPS 1 site index, which must find its runway in G3).  The 82 words landing_sites.py already wrote from ksc.json (KSC 15/33 in slots 1-2, their MLS and TACAN) are left as it wrote them.  G3's flown table matches G16's in all but 9 of these words.

#PCGGC01, #PCGGD01, #PCGGC13, #PCGG01R: the RTLS/TAL/ATO guidance and abort-boundary words. Left out: the cells sts134-reconfig.json sets or the launch day superseded (V_MAG_MECO_NOM, RAD_MECO_NOM, CGGV_RAD_MECO, FPA_MECO_NOM, ROLL_CMD_CHANGE_V, ASSUMED_SSME_FAIL_MET, K_CMD_NOM -- none is LM on the volume) CGGS_P_Y_INDEX_CHG_LIMIT (tied to the 2011 first-stage pitch/yaw tables), and CGGB_EF_PLANE_SW: flown OFF (an inertial target plane rotated from #PCGGCOM's T_GMTLO_REF, the 2010 build's day 210 -- a launch-day product), and with it OFF second stage on our KSC6 tape pitched up 25 deg after SRB SEP and fell back (bisected 2026-10-10); the tape's ON (the earth-fixed plane) flies to the ISS plane. #PCGGC13 has a second copy in G3 (flat addr+1135264); only the G1 copy is patched.

D-csects (G1): #DGG42ND (TAL SSME trim mass, K_CMD_STG2 106 -> 104), #DGG9GLI and #DGHHPHA (glide RTLS), #DGDORTL, #DGEHRTL, #DGSTETS (RTLS ET SEP inhibit limits, ETSEP_INH_TIME), #DGSSSSM (the low-level cutoff delays: DT_DRY 1.918 -> 0.238 s, RTLS_DT_DRY, PTM_DT_DRY, both LH2 LL delays -> 0; prevalve close delays), #DGSMMPS, #DGSFABT, #DGSQASC. Left out: #DGG31ST (first stage, launch-day coupled), #DGSRRSL (RSLS countdown timing), #DGSESRB (already the flown values).

Every cell is placed flat (the csect's one copy, found by a +/-32 hw context and checked over the csect's whole range against an OPS 1 capture), with 'was' the tape's value: a context search with --mem matched blank (zero) neighbourhoods all over the volume.
